message: every queued episode is either already in the ledger or not yet pushed to R2
disposition_why: 'NOTHING_SHELVED' has now stopped cloud-upload on 8 consecutive runs (limit 7), so it is not resolving itself. Seven consecutive days of an empty shelf while episodes remain unuploaded means the Mac is not pushing - bin/push-to-r2.sh is failing, or the nightly com.howweknow.batch agent is not firing at all. Compare the count of renders/*-final.mp4 on the Mac with the ledger; if the Mac has more, the push is the broken half, not this lane.
